description: A declarative stencil definition used to create diagram nodes.

members.name: Category
members.description: Category used for grouping in the toolbox (e.g. "UML", "BPMN", "General").

members.name: ConnectionPoints
members.description: Predefined fixed connection points on the stencil perimeter, draw.io style. When populated, these render as hover dots and create edges with DiagramConnectionConstraint instead of floating port snapping.

members.name: DefaultData
members.description: Default data values for nodes created from this stencil.

members.name: DefaultHeight
members.description: Default height when dropped onto the canvas.

members.name: DefaultWidth
members.description: Default width when dropped onto the canvas.

members.name: EdgeDefaults
members.description: Default edge values when Kind is Edge.

members.name: ExternalAssetSourceId
members.description: Optional external asset source identifier. Built-in Tempo stencils leave this empty.

members.name: IconSvg
members.description: Compact SVG icon for the toolbox.

members.name: Id
members.description: Unique stencil identifier (e.g. "uml.class").

members.name: IsCollapsible
members.description: Whether nodes created from this stencil support collapse/expand.

members.name: IsSwimlane
members.description: Whether nodes created from this stencil act as swimlane containers.

members.name: IsTable
members.description: Whether nodes created from this stencil act as tables.

members.name: Keywords
members.description: Additional search keywords for toolbox discovery.

members.name: Kind
members.description: Kind of diagram element created by this stencil.

members.name: Layout
members.description: Declarative layout defining the visual appearance.

members.name: Name
members.description: Human-readable name displayed in the toolbox.

members.name: NameResourceKey
members.description: Localization resource key used for the stencil display name.

members.name: Order
members.description: Display order within the palette.

members.name: Origin
members.description: Origin metadata used to keep built-in stencil libraries license-safe.

members.name: PaletteId
members.description: Logical palette identifier within the set (e.g. "uml25.class").

members.name: PaletteNameResourceKey
members.description: Localization resource key used for the owning palette display name.

members.name: PaletteOrder
members.description: Display order of the owning palette within the set.

members.name: Ports
members.description: Default ports generated for nodes created from this stencil.

members.name: SetId
members.description: Logical stencil set identifier (e.g. "uml25", "bpmn2").

members.name: SetNameResourceKey
members.description: Localization resource key used for the owning set display name.

members.name: Tags
members.description: Search tags for toolbox discovery.
